component.alias: HaloKey, Kwikset, Kwikset Halo, Halo, Halo (keypad), Halo Touch, Halo Select, Halo Select Plus, HaloLink, Wi-Fi Lock, Smart Lock, Deadbolt, Door Lock
component.notes:
HaloKey: Kwikset Halo / Halo Touch / Halo Select Wi-Fi locks through the HaloKey bridge service (the halolink service; this profile keeps the original name, Kwikset HaloLink). Up to 8 locks on one component. Full manual: the Documentation tab (also MANUAL.pdf in the release package).
A BRIDGE IS REQUIRED This profile talks to the HaloKey bridge, a small service that signs in to the Kwikset cloud for Savant. Run it either on the Savant Pro host itself (macOS: macos/install.sh, the usual setup), or on another always-on computer on the same network (Mac or Linux). On another computer, add the Savant host's IP to allowed_clients in the bridge's config.json, or the bridge refuses Savant's connection.
SETUP 1. Install the bridge and sign in once: halolink login (Kwikset email, password, then the code Kwikset sends). halolink list shows each lock's number. 2. Ethernet: set Device IP Address to the machine running the bridge (the host's own IP when the bridge runs on the host). Port 2370. 3. Optional: "Kwikset Home" state variable = the home name from the Kwikset app, if the account has more than one home. Blank = the bridge's config.json setting (default: every home). 4. Optional: "Disable Unlock" state variable = YES makes the Savant app lock-only. Blank or NO = full control. 5. Fill in the Door Lock data table (below), click Done, and upload the configuration.
DOOR LOCK DATA TABLE: one row per lock. One Kwikset HaloLink component covers every lock on the account. Controller this Kwikset HaloLink component Location the zone the lock belongs to Entity Lock DoorLockAddress [1] the lock number from halolink list (1, 2, 3 ...) Label the name shown in the Savant app, e.g. Front Door Status State [component name].DoorLock.DoorLockStatus_n (Locked / Unlocked) Error State [component name].DoorLock.DoorLockError_n (blank unless there is a problem) Camera Mapping optional: a camera to show with the lock n is the lock number from DoorLockAddress [1]. Example, lock 1 on a component named Front Door Lock: Status State = Front Door Lock.DoorLock.DoorLockStatus_1, Error State = Front Door Lock.DoorLock.DoorLockError_1
STATES (n = lock number) LOCKn_STATUS Locked/Unlocked/Jammed/Unknown, LOCKn_LOCKED 1/0, LOCKn_PENDING, LOCKn_BATTERY, LOCKn_BATTERY_LOW, LOCKn_DOOR Open/Closed, LOCKn_ONLINE, LOCKn_ERROR ... (full list in STATES.md) Who did it: LOCKn_LAST_EVENT Locked/Unlocked, LOCKn_LAST_SOURCE Keypad/Manual/App, LOCKn_LAST_USER. While a lock is offline its STATUS is Unknown; LOCKn_LAST_KNOWN keeps the last reported status. Savant-standard: DoorLockStatus_n, IsDoorLocked_n, DoorLockError_n, DoorStatus_n, IsDoorClosed_n, BatteryLevel_n. SYS_ALL_LOCKED, SYS_UNLOCKED_NAMES, SYS_LOW_BATTERY_NAMES, SYS_ONLINE, SYS_AUTH, SYS_LIVE. Gate automations on SYS_ONLINE = 1. SYS_AUTH = reauth_required means: run halolink login again.
Lock state is only ever set from what Kwikset reports, never assumed from a button press.
====================== Change Log ================== Version: 1.1.7 Change: Import fix. The profile, Documentation tab page and icon now sit side by side in profile/blueprint-import, which is where Blueprint looks for them; in 1.1.2-1.1.6 they were in subfolders, so a fresh import got no icon and no Documentation tab. Version: 1.1.6 Change: First public release, as HaloKey (the profile, service and halolink command keep the HaloLink name). Search aliases (Kwikset, Halo, Halo Touch, Halo Select, ...) so the profile is easy to find in Blueprint. Supported-lock list corrected: Bluetooth-only Aura locks are not supported. Version: 1.1.5 Change: Manual screenshots. The Documentation tab is the full user manual (MANUAL.md), and the profile ships only in profile/blueprint-import. Version: 1.1.4 Change: Full lock and unlock control by default. New "Disable Unlock" state variable (YES = lock only) and SYS_UNLOCK_ALLOWED. Door Lock data table: Status State is DoorLockStatus_n (the 1.1.1-1.1.3 notes said IsDoorLocked_n, which the Savant app reads as Unlocked). New DoorLockError_n for Error State. Commands sent by the bridge show LOCKn_LAST_SOURCE = Savant. Version: 1.1.3 Change: Offline locks show Unknown (last status kept in LOCKn_LAST_KNOWN); online read from Kwikset's deviceconnectivitystatus. New LOCKn_LAST_SOURCE (Keypad/Manual/App), LOCKn_LAST_USER and LOCKn_LAST_EVENT_TIME from the Kwikset history. Version: 1.1.2 Change: Shipped in Blueprint's import layout (blueprint-import folder) so the Documentation tab and icon import with the profile. Version: 1.1.1 Change: Notes cover the bridge requirement and every Door Lock data table column. Added the Documentation tab page and component icon. Version: 1.1.0 Change: First release. Savant connection on port 2370.
